title: Browser importers
description: Reusable browser discovery scripts learned and repaired by OpenCode with Browser Harness and Stagehand.

x_posts.title: Posts
x_posts.description: Import your X posts. Learns the browser workflow on first use and repairs it when needed.
x_posts.task:
- Discover canonical URLs for this account's X posts.
- Start at the configured URL, or https://x.com.
- Identify the signed-in account; exclude unrelated recommendations.

IMPORTERS_BROWSER_ACCOUNT.title: Require account (optional)
IMPORTERS_BROWSER_ACCOUNT.description: The signed-in account is detected automatically. Optionally restrict discovery to a particular handle or email.

IMPORTERS_BROWSER_URL.title: Source URL (optional)
IMPORTERS_BROWSER_URL.description: A particular profile, activity page, spreadsheet, or folder. Leave blank to discover it from your signed-in account.

importers_setup.title: Use a dedicated browser profile
importers_setup.description: Install the ArchiveBox extension in a separate Chrome or Brave profile. Sign in to the account you want to import.

importers_setup.title: Sync to a server persona
importers_setup.description: In the extension, select your ArchiveBox server and sync this profile to a persona. Choose that same persona here.

importers_setup.title: Preview, then import
importers_setup.description: Save this importer and choose Preview. Confirm the account and discovered links, then choose Import all.
